metadata.lab: Laboratory Work No. 3 — Comparison of metric methods and Support Vector Machines

additional_metrics: ROC-AUC for the selected model when a continuous score is available

regular_models.LogisticRegression: fixed C=1, StandardScaler; control/reference from prior classification work, not re-tuned

hypotheses.hypothesis: Scaling affects distance-based and SVM classifiers because it changes the geometry of the feature space.
hypotheses.experiment: For fixed kNN, linear SVM, RBF SVM and NearestCentroid configurations, compare no scaling, StandardScaler and MinMaxScaler on the same StratifiedKFold.
hypotheses.confirmation_criterion: CV macro-F1 or its fold variability changes across scaler choices; interpret model families separately.

hypotheses.hypothesis: The choice of Minkowski distance, number of neighbors and voting weights changes kNN performance.
hypotheses.experiment: Grid search k in {1,3,5,7,11}, p in {1,2}, weights in {uniform,distance}, using a fixed scaler choice from the scaling experiment.
hypotheses.confirmation_criterion: At least one tested setting differs in CV macro-F1 beyond trivial fold noise, and best parameters are recorded.

hypotheses.hypothesis: RBF SVM may better represent a non-linear boundary than linear SVM, at the cost of different latency/model size.
hypotheses.experiment: Compare linear SVM C grid with RBF SVM joint C/gamma grid using the same training split and folds.
hypotheses.confirmation_criterion: Compare mean CV macro-F1 and SD together with final candidate size and latency; do not assume RBF must win.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Adding independent non-informative dimensions reduces the usefulness of Euclidean neighborhoods for kNN.
hypotheses.experiment: Add fixed-seed random features with comparable [0,1] scale and record median dmin/dmax and CV macro-F1.
hypotheses.confirmation_criterion: Distance ratio tends toward 1 while CV macro-F1 falls as noise-feature count rises.

final_model_selection.rationale: Predeclared one-standard-error engineering rule: keep candidates within one SE of the best mean CV macro-F1, then prefer smaller serialized model size, lower training-only prediction latency, and finally higher CV macro-F1.

out_of_fold_disagreement_analysis.method: manual stratified out-of-fold predictions; each row is predicted by models not fitted on that row
out_of_fold_disagreement_analysis.caveat: The selected hyperparameters were chosen using CV on this same training partition. OOF predictions are out-of-fold for fitting, but this disagreement analysis is diagnostic rather than a fully nested, unbiased estimate of the entire tuning procedure.

dimensionality_noise_experiment.purpose: Controlled test of how independent, non-informative dimensions affect distances and KNN.
dimensionality_noise_experiment.scaling: noise is generated on raw training rows; MinMaxScaler and imputation remain inside each CV Pipeline fold; distance-ratio is a separate training-only descriptive calculation

dimensionality_noise_experiment.note: CV metrics are diagnostic; synthetic noise features are not retained in the final classifier.

controlled_geometry_experiment.explanation: This controlled geometric experiment is separate from the Hill-Valley holdout. It isolates how a 18× scale distortion changes distance-based and margin-based decision boundaries.

selection_details.rationale: Predeclared one-standard-error engineering rule: keep candidates within one SE of the best mean CV macro-F1, then prefer smaller serialized model size, lower training-only prediction latency, and finally higher CV macro-F1.

small_dataset_needing_neighbor_explanati.reason: Can explain a prediction by showing nearest training examples, their classes and distances; confirm performance and latency from this run before a real deployment.

high_query_volume_strict_latency.reason: Chosen here as the lowest measured prediction latency on a training-only profile; compare the associated CV macro-F1 and serialized size before accepting.

methodological_limitations: The test set is used only after selection, but a random holdout from the same dataset is not a new external population.
For --test-data, results depend on the provenance and separation of the supplied test file.
Scaler choice is selected on training CV scores; reported best scores may be optimistic due to finite search. A nested CV would estimate the full tuning procedure more conservatively.

OOF model-disagreement predictions are out-of-fold for fitting, but hyperparameters were chosen using the same training CV, so the disagreement set is diagnostic rather than a completely unbiased performance estimate.
The distance/noise experiment is controlled and diagnostic only; random synthetic dimensions are not used in the final classifier.
Wall-clock latency and model size depend on hardware, software versions and process load; measured values are environment-specific.
